# Native on_road_built hook (avoids CIconDatabase<SRoadTypeIconDatabase> errors on nested blocks in road_types/*.txt).
on_road_built = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_amr_on_road_built
	}
}

oe_amr_on_road_built = {
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
		exists = scope:road_type
		scope:road_type = road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_first_qhapaq_nan }
	}
	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_first_qhapaq_nan value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.10
	}
}
